Two of a dissertation's words, in English.

The label over the appendices in the table of contents is APPENDICES, which
is now Quarto's section-title-appendices in capitals. apaquarto had declared
that key as section-title-appendixes, which is not Quarto's, so Quarto's
translation never reached it; the English must come out as it always has.

The heading of the list of tables is named by thesis-list-of-tables, the
same words as the list-of-tables field that asks for the list. It was
thesis-list-of-table, singular, which nobody would guess.
